title: 捡回来
logline: 16岁少年江野在父亲江建军的严苛晨训中磨出不服输的韧劲，诠释十年坚持的意义。

shots.narrationZh: 凌晨四点，老球馆的灯，亮了十年。
shots.narrationEn: The lights of the old training gym have been on at 4 a.m. for ten years.
shots.visual: Jiang Ye in a red sweat-soaked jersey swings his paddle on the worn wooden floor of the old training gym, with Jiang Jianjun standing opposite holding a ping pong ball, baskets of balls stacked in the corner, old championship flags hanging on the wall, early morning light seeping through the high windows.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉缓有力，语速偏慢，『十年』重读带厚重感，气息下沉，末尾稍作停顿

shots.visual: Jiang Jianjun in a worn old sports jacket with frayed cuffs smashes a fast ping pong ball towards Jiang Ye, his hard forearm muscles taut.

lines.en: Keep your center of gravity low.

shots.ttsDirection: 冷硬沉静，语速平缓，字字咬实，气息稳无起伏，末尾微顿

shots.visual: Jiang Ye slams his paddle on the floor in frustration, sweat dripping from his short hair, white athletic tape wrapped around his wrist, his red jersey soaked through.
shots.ttsDirection: 爆发带委屈，语速稍快，『练不动了』重读拖长，气息急促，末尾带怒意余韵

shots.visual: Jiang Jianjun stands still with a blank expression, silver strands visible in his short cropped hair, pointing at the paddle on the floor.
shots.ttsDirection: 冷硬无波，语速极慢，字字如砸，气息沉，『捡回来』三字重读，停顿半秒

shots.narrationEn: What you pick up is never the ball, it's the refusal to give up.
shots.visual: The ping pong ball grazes the net and drops to the floor, both Jiang Ye and Jiang Jianjun stay silent, then cut to close-up of a high-performance ping pong paddle with the brand logo, with the tagline 'Forged in 4 a.m. training' appearing below.
shots.ttsDirection: 沉稳有力，语速放缓，『不服』重读带顿挫，气息下沉，末尾收得干净留余韵
